objectives.statement: Recognize and use regular comparative and superlative adverb forms with -ere and -est.
Use mer and mest with longer adverbs to compare how something happens.
Use common irregular adverb comparisons: bra, bedre, best and dårlig, verre, verst.
Choose adverb comparison when comparing actions, not nouns.

notes: Must teach comparison of adverbs (fortere, bedre, best, mer, mest, verst) as distinct from adjective_comparison. Cover regular -ere/-est adverb comparison, mer/mest with long adverbs, and common irregulars (bra/bedre/best, dårlig/verre/verst). Defer adjective comparison forms to adjective_comparison.
